program.name: Workforce threshold: prioritize inn
program.source: let phase='watch';let triggeredWorkers=0;const inn={id:1,generation:1};function step(ctx){if(phase==='done')return {};if(phase==='verify'){const b=ctx.game.building(inn);phase='done';const success=!!b&&b.priority===1;ctx.wakeAgent({key:'workforce-inn-result',reason:success?'Workforce exceeded fifteen; inn high priority confirmed. Report to the player.':'Workforce exceeded fifteen, but inn high priority could not be confirmed. Report to the player.',data:{tick:ctx.tick,observedWorkersAtTrigger:triggeredWorkers,success,inn}});return {output:{success,complete:true}};}const workers=ctx.game.units({team:ctx.myTeam,limit:200}).filter(u=>u.type===0).length;if(workers<=15)return {output:{observedWorkers:workers}};triggeredWorkers=workers;const b=ctx.game.building(inn);if(!b){phase='done';ctx.wakeAgent({key:'workforce-inn-result',reason:'Workforce exceeded fifteen, but the designated inn no longer exists. Report to the player.',data:{tick:ctx.tick,observedWorkers:workers,success:false}});return {output:{complete:true,success:false}};}if(b.priority===1){phase='verify';return {output:{observedWorkers:workers,alreadyHigh:true}};}phase='verify';return {output:{observedWorkers:workers,priorityOrderQueued:true},orders:[{type:'priority',building:inn,priority:1}]};}
